sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • For individuals with a diagnosis of either type 1 or type 2 diabetes, measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE once every three months. • For individuals with a diagnosis of prediabetes, annual screening for type 2 diabetes with a measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE. • Screening for prediabetes or type 2 diabetes with a measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 3 years in individuals 18 years of age and older with any of the following: – Cardiovascular disease – Family history of diabetes – High-risk race/ethnicity (e.g., African American, Latino or Hispanic, Native American, Asian American or Pacific Islander) at risk for type 2 diabetes (e.g., obesity) – History of gestational diabetes – Hypercholesterolemia – Hypertension – Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) – Metabolic syndrome – Other clinical conditions associated with insulin resistance (e.g., acanthosis nigricans) – Overweight or obese – Physical inactivity – Polycystic ovary syndrome • Screening for diabetes with an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) (CPT code 82951, CPT code 82952) or measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 3 years for children ages 10 – 17 with at least one of the following: – Acanthosis nigricans – Dyslipidemia – Family history of type 2 diabetes – Hypertension – Overweight or obese – Polycystic ovary syndrome • For individuals 10 years of age or older who have been diagnosed with cystic fibrosis (CF), screening for CF-related diabetes with an OGTT (CPT code 82951, CPT code 82952) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 365 days. • For pregnant individuals, an OGTT (CPT code 82951, CPT code 82952) IS REIMBURSABLE up to once per month during pregnancy.
